_comment: Restricted profiles: an implementation that supports a SUBSET of the language.
A profile lists the cases it may legitimately reject, with the reason. Any case NOT listed
must parse identically to <case>.expected.json. That is what keeps a subset a subset rather
than letting it drift into a separate grammar.

gba.description: tish-gba: build-time bake to LR35902 + GBA PCM. Two generators, no session/automation/co-DJ.

mayReject.003-steps-and-locks: step_prob/ratchet/nudge are dropped at bake; `steps euclid` must be expanded to notes
mayReject.005-mix-fx-voice-deck: fx / voice / deck routing have no hardware meaning
mayReject.006-globals: swing, scale, xfade, deck_mix, master_mix, actor_mix are host-mixer concepts
mayReject.007-session-song-follow: no session grid, clips, song arrangement, follow actions or automation
mayReject.008-macros-genblock: macros and gen_block are not baked
mayReject.011-golden: uses generators and sections outside the GBA subset
mayReject.001-comments-and-sharps: uses `scale`, which has no GBA meaning (the sharp-name parsing it pins is still exercised by 012)
mayReject.002-track-header: uses `remove_track`, an incremental host edit fragment
